description:
In our game Pixel House, you paint houses. It's more than just a classic coloring book: you become the designer! Plan color patterns, create harmonious designs, and experiment with style.

For extra relaxation, we've added a music player. Listen to calming music while creating your dream home.

Main features:
• Paint houses and their elements from scratch.
• Relax with music right in the game.
• Use your imagination to create your own style.
• Play offline and share your creations with friends.
name: Pixel House: Color by Number
intro: The dream home starts here: paint, listen, relax.
